concepts.subject: Diverse Team Meeting
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a bright and airy conference room with a diverse group of 5 professionals seated around a wooden table, warm lighting, natural colors, and a friendly atmosphere, shot from a slightly elevated angle, with a mix of ages, ethnicities, and abilities, and a cityscape outside the window.
concepts.title: Diverse Business Team Meeting
concepts.description: A group of diverse professionals are seated around a conference table in a modern office, engaged in a discussion. The room is filled with natural light and has a city view.

concepts.subject: Person Meditating Outdoors
concepts.image_prompt: Create a serene and peaceful scene of a person meditating in a lush green forest, soft and warm lighting, pastel colors, and a sense of calmness, shot from a low angle, with a misty atmosphere, and a focus on the person's relaxed pose.
concepts.title: Person Meditating in Nature
concepts.description: A person is sitting in a cross-legged pose, meditating in a peaceful forest surroundings, surrounded by greenery and a misty atmosphere.

concepts.subject: Delicious Fresh Fruit Salad
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a vibrant and appetizing image of a fresh fruit salad in a bowl, bright and colorful lighting, and a mix of exotic fruits, shot from a directly overhead angle, with a focus on the textures and colors of the fruits.
concepts.title: Fresh Fruit Salad Bowl
concepts.description: A bowl of fresh fruit salad, containing a variety of exotic fruits such as kiwi, strawberries, and pineapple, arranged in a decorative pattern.

concepts.subject: Person Working Remote
concepts.image_prompt: Create a modern and sleek image of a person working remotely from a coffee shop, with a laptop and a cup of coffee, warm and cozy lighting, and a blurred background, shot from a slightly low angle, with a focus on the person's focused expression.
concepts.title: Remote Work at Coffee Shop
concepts.description: A person is sitting at a small table in a coffee shop, working on a laptop, with a cup of coffee and a notepad, surrounded by a blurred background of other coffee shop patrons.

concepts.subject: Beautiful Sunset Landscape
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a stunning and dramatic image of a beautiful sunset landscape, with a range of hills and mountains in the distance, warm and golden lighting, and a sense of vastness, shot from a high angle, with a focus on the colors and textures of the landscape.
concepts.title: Sunset Landscape with Hills
concepts.description: A panoramic view of a beautiful sunset landscape, with a range of hills and mountains in the distance, and a vast sky with warm and golden colors.

concepts.subject: Diverse Group Friends
concepts.image_prompt: Create a vibrant and lively image of a diverse group of friends, from different ethnicities and abilities, standing together and smiling, bright and colorful lighting, and a sense of camaraderie, shot from a slightly low angle, with a focus on the group's energetic and playful atmosphere.
concepts.title: Diverse Group of Friends
concepts.description: A group of diverse friends, from different ethnicities and abilities, are standing together and smiling, with their arms around each other, in a park or outdoor setting.

concepts.subject: Person Practicing Yoga
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a serene and peaceful image of a person practicing yoga, in a calm and natural environment, soft and warm lighting, and a sense of relaxation, shot from a slightly elevated angle, with a focus on the person's calm and focused expression.
concepts.title: Person Practicing Yoga Outdoors
concepts.description: A person is practicing yoga in a calm and natural environment, surrounded by greenery and a peaceful atmosphere, with a focus on the person's calm and focused expression.

concepts.subject: Person Working from Home
concepts.image_prompt: Create a modern and cozy image of a person working from home, with a laptop and a cup of coffee, warm and inviting lighting, and a sense of comfort, shot from a slightly low angle, with a focus on the person's relaxed and productive atmosphere.
concepts.title: Person Working from Home Office
concepts.description: A person is sitting at a desk in a home office, working on a laptop, with a cup of coffee and a notepad, surrounded by a cozy and inviting atmosphere.

concepts.subject: Family Having Picnic
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a happy and lively image of a family having a picnic, in a park or outdoor setting, bright and colorful lighting, and a sense of joy, shot from a slightly elevated angle, with a focus on the family's playful and affectionate atmosphere.
concepts.title: Family Having Picnic in Park
concepts.description: A family is having a picnic in a park, with a blanket, a basket of food, and a few outdoor games, surrounded by a lively and playful atmosphere.

concepts.subject: Person Hiking in Mountains
concepts.image_prompt: Create a stunning and dramatic image of a person hiking in the mountains, with a breathtaking view and a sense of adventure, bright and colorful lighting, and a focus on the person's energetic and determined expression.
concepts.title: Person Hiking in Mountain Landscape
concepts.description: A person is hiking in the mountains, with a backpack and hiking poles, surrounded by a stunning and dramatic landscape, with a breathtaking view and a sense of adventure.
